findings.spec: FR-13: same response whether or not the email belongs to an owner
findings.summary: A known email creates links and sends an email before answering, so it takes longer than an unknown one (same class as F-28-2).
findings.reason: not measured against real Resend latency; a complete fix sends from a job queue (not built)

findings.summary: FR-24 says email verification comes before first sign-in. An owner whose account email is not yet verified can still get an emailed sign-in link (the link itself proves the inbox). The SPEC does not say whether an emailed-link sign-in counts as the 'first sign-in'. In practice a self-signup business has no location until the operator sets it up, so no link is sent before then.

The reader asks for FORMATTED_VALUE. If an owner types a date that Sheets turns into a date cell shown in a locale format (for example 11/24/2026), parseTime (ISO only) rejects visit_time as invalid_visit_time, and an unparsed consent_date drops the phone to email only. Both fail safe and give a reason, but real rows could be rejected. The code comment says cells read 'as the owner typed it', which depends on Google's formatting.
findings.reason: needs a check against a real Google Sheet (no outside accounts allowed); recommend the template formats these columns as plain text, or reading the date columns with valueRenderOption=UNFORMATTED_VALUE plus dateTimeRenderOption=FORMATTED_STRING

findings.summary: googleSheetsConfigFromEnv rejects a private key stored with CRLF line endings (a clear configuration error, not a SPEC issue).

The Implementation status table (synced at ca05c82) is out of date after this period: FR-13 still says no page requests an emailed link (#36 added one); FR-2a still says there is no Google Sheets API reader (#37 added one; there is still no 15-minute schedule); FR-24 still lists the missing per-email sign-up limit (#34 fixed it). The next SPEC sync should update these rows, in both docs/SPEC.md and the Doc.

observations: #34 re-read against FR-24: the per-email sign-up limit counts every attempt and answers the same 429 for known and unknown emails. F-28-1 is closed.
#37 traced through pollSheet: header row first, blank rows dropped, errors carry only status and code (no cell values, tokens or key), read-only scope, no owner OAuth (FR-2a, logging rule).

#36 traced through createSignInLink, redeemSignInToken and resetPassword: links are single use, 15 minutes, one location each; sessions are tied to the account only when its email matches the business owner email; offboarded businesses and disabled accounts get nothing; limits are per IP and per email.
